name: Sacrificial Rite's haste clauses (#3188 - its attacker clause needs a Ghost test)
contract: Sacrificial Rite 800785 reads 'Invoke a dark ritual, increasing your haste by $s1% for $d. While active, attackers are afflicted with Cursed Blood. Can only occur once per sec.' Spell.dbc gives it three effects: effect 0 is aura 192 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE and effect 2 is aura 216 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CASTING_SPEED_NOT_STACK, both BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = +20%, over DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms; effect 1 is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Cursed Blood 573250. This scenario covers the two haste clauses, which are native: AuraEffect::HandleModMeleeRangedSpeedPct divides UNIT_FIELD_BASEATTACKTIME by 1.20 and HandleModCastingSpeed divides UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED by 1.20, so both ratios must land on 1/1.2 = 0.8333. Frostbolt 116 is only a cast-time probe; spell_cast_time_ms submits no cast and does not require the spell to be known. NOT PROVABLE HERE - the attacker clause. Spell.dbc gives 800785 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped the record and no attacker was ever cursed; rev_20260920_44_bloodmage_melee_event_procs.sql adds the row with ProcFlags 139944 = 0x222a8, which is entirely TAKEN flags and so needs a unit that actually swings at the Bloodmage. CoAGameplayTest.cpp forces every fixture creature to REACT_PASSIVE at creation and again after CombatStop, and CreatureAI::UpdateVictim takes the passive branch for a creature in combat and calls me->AttackStop() (src/server/game/AI/CreatureAI.cpp:372-379); CreatureAI::AttackedBy is an empty stub (src/server/game/AI/CreatureAI.h:180). A fixture creature therefore never retaliates, whatever its faction, so the clause cannot be observed here. A Ghost e2e test would have to: put a class-20 character in a zone with an ordinary hostile world mob, cast Sacrificial Rite 800785, pull the mob so that it lands at least one melee swing on the character while the 15 s buff is up, and check that aura 573250 is on the mob with the character as caster. 800785 has ExcludeCasterAuraSpell 802877, so no Cursed Form marker is fixtured.
